Japan's River Act classifies rivers as Class A / Class B / ordinary — an administrative system rather than a size ranking, so it is not used here. This map instead uses two tiers by prominence and length, and hides unnamed rivers under 60 km to keep the view clean. Labels use simplified Chinese transliterations where they exist, otherwise the original Japanese name.
